metadata.title: Disco Era Portrait with Neon Inline Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up studio portrait of a woman with a 1970s bouffant hairstyle, set against a dark, moody background. The composition is dominated by large, stylized neon-style custom lettering at the top that uses multiple parallel strokes to create a sense of movement and light.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant red and white neon lettering contrasts sharply against the deep black background.
The subject's soft, warm skin tones balance the hard, geometric lines of the typography.
The top-heavy typographic layout creates a frame for the subject's face.
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting with soft shadows
Multi-line inline stroke effect on primary display text
Dark, desaturated background to emphasize foreground elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium-close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized initial letter of the primary text acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large neon text, move down to the subject's face, and finally to the horizontal bar at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper corners and background focuses attention on the subject and the glowing text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Red (Typography) creates energy and a disco aesthetic.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lavender/Purple (Bottom Bar) and White (Inline strokes) provide highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography against low value, low saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary blues or greens to maintain the warm, moody 70s palette.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses 3-4 parallel inline strokes.
Outer stroke is red; inner strokes are white/light blue.
Letters feature elongated descenders and swashes that interlock.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter is oversized and circular, enclosing vertical parallel lines.
The final letter features a long horizontal tail acting as an underline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, multi-line display face paired with a fluid, elegant script for contrast.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rectangular bar at the bottom right for metadata.
Curved swashes that integrate with the letterforms.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, handwritten feel of the subtitle.
The primary display text is too specific for a standard font; it requires custom pathing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with a 70s hairstyle, warm lighting on the face, dark black background, medium shot, high quality photography.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large custom neon lettering at the top using three parallel strokes (red outer, white inner). Add a small white script above it. Place a lavender horizontal bar in the bottom right corner with bold white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Typography has a distinct multi-line inline effect.
Background is solid dark or very dark gradient.
Color palette is restricted to red, white, black, and lavender.

adjustableVariables: Number of inline strokes in the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp vector lines for typography
Professional studio-quality lighting on the subject
High contrast between text and background
avoid: Blurry or pixelated edges on text
Flat, uninteresting lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Does the script font feel era-appropriate?
Is the lavender bar correctly positioned at the bottom right?
Is the lighting on the subject consistent with a studio setting?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a moody studio portrait with custom multi-line neon typography at the top and a high-contrast metadata bar at the bottom.
